# Northcrest Studio

> Northcrest Studio is a founder-led website studio in Calgary, Alberta, that builds websites for trades businesses: roofers, landscapers, plumbers, electricians, renovators and framers. Main offer: the Trades Growth Site, $1,999 once and the client owns it (smaller 5-page site $999), with Care at $79 a month, first 3 months free. Monthly plans from $129 (CAD, plus GST). The homepage is designed free before the client pays anything.

## Key facts
- Founder: Thomas Martinez, who personally reviews every site before launch.
- Based in Calgary, Alberta. Serves Calgary, Airdrie, Cochrane, Chestermere and Okotoks.
- Contact: call or text (587) 583-8450, email hello@northcreststudio.ca. Hours: Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm.
- First client: Hermes Framing (https://hermesframing.ca).
- Payment: card or Interac e-Transfer. All prices in CAD, plus GST.

## Websites to own (paid once)
- Trades Starter Site: $999. Up to 5 pages: services, service areas, gallery, a quote form with photo upload, and click-to-call. Or we fix the client's current site instead, same price. Live in 7 business days.
- Trades Growth Site: $1,999. 6 to 15 pages: a page per service, local SEO, Google profile setup, reviews and a before-and-after gallery. Live in 7 business days.
- Care: $79 a month for hosting, backups, edits and domain renewal. First 3 months free when you buy a site.

## Monthly plans
- Starter $129/month, Growth $199/month, Premium $349/month. 12-month minimum, then month to month. Premium includes a custom logo, automatic Google review requests and priority edits (up to 2 hours a month).

## Add-ons
- Brand Kit (logo, colours, fonts, business cards): $399, included in Premium.
- Google Profile Tune-Up: $149, credited toward setup within 30 days.
- Job Site Photo Day (30 edited photos plus drone shots): $449.
